thread:
lia: heads up — noticed area charts freeze when switching series on dashboard after last night's rollout. Users hit long frames, console spam.
sam: can you paste the repro steps + approx user org? any console traces?
lia: quick steps: open dashboard > timeframe 30d > click series toggle rapidly. Happens on chrome/mac, staging and prod. devtools: large main-thread tasks, memory climb.
sam: rough profile? stack traces or flame? :eyes:
lia: attached small excerpt:
```
Long Task (1200ms) at chart-render
  at renderSeries (charts.js:452)
  at updateBindings (widget.ts:88)
```
michael: saw a quota/routing change merged in platform yesterday — increased telemetry fanout to 2x for analytics endpoints. pinging @anita
deploy-bot: deploy redwood-console@release-2026.03.19 to production by jon — 2962998800
anita: yes, rolled telemetry shim that multiplexes events to /events+ /v2/telemetry for now. goal was reliability, but ack might increase queue pressure.
jon: also toggled KV prefetch affinity to 'aggressive' in the canary config — that can cause more cache churn if many widgets bind/unbind.
maria: wondering if this is a batching vs immediate render issue — aggressive prefetch -> more data serialized on main thread.
sam: can we try reverting telemetry shim in staging and flip KV prefetch to 'normal' in canary? I can push quick canary if y'all agree.
lia: staging repro is flaky but reverts would be great. thanks.
anita: rolling back shim in staging now, will post status.
sam: if rollback doesn't help we should trace per-widget event counts and remote calls; could be double-send on toggle.
lia: also observed bigger bundle size + source maps show a new analytics adapter file ~75kb added to main chunk
jon: noted. that adapter was imported directly in dashboard boot to ensure early init — we should lazy-load it instead.
michael: plan: rollback shim in staging, change import to dynamic() on dashboard boot, and set KV prefetch to normal in canary. target: fix and canary smoke in 2 hours. :100:
sam: I'll open a quick PR for dynamic import and run perf lab.
maria: creating incident ticket for internal tracking.
lia: thanks team — I'll watch error rate and user reports. :heart:
